plastic_bag_film.handling_guidance: Keep separate from recyclable materials and dispose of through the appropriate general-waste or soft-plastic collection stream where available.

cigarette.handling_guidance: Ensure the cigarette is fully extinguished and dispose of it securely in the general-waste stream.

small_accessory.handling_guidance: Collect small accessories securely and place them in the appropriate general-waste stream unless a specific recycling facility accepts them.

scrap_metal.handling_guidance: Keep separate from general waste. Confirm the item condition and that the selected station accepts metal before recycling.

plastic_bottle.handling_guidance: Keep separate from general waste. Confirm the item condition and that the selected station accepts plastic before recycling.
plastic_bottle.hazardous_handling_guidance: Keep separate from general waste and ordinary recycling stations. Contact an appropriate hazardous-waste collector for the confirmed contents.

questions.prompt: Is the item empty and clean?

drink_can.handling_guidance: Keep separate from general waste. Confirm the item condition and that the selected station accepts metal before recycling.

questions.prompt: Confirm the specific plastic material and local disposal route.

other_plastic.handling_guidance: Confirm the plastic type and whether a suitable local collection stream accepts it; do not place it in an ordinary recycling bin based only on appearance.

questions.prompt: Is the item clean and dry?

paper.handling_guidance: Keep separate from general waste. Confirm the item condition and that the selected station accepts paper before recycling.

Is the item empty and clean?

glass.handling_guidance: Keep separate from general waste. Confirm the item condition and that the selected station accepts glass before recycling.
glass.hazardous_handling_guidance: Keep separate from general waste and ordinary recycling stations. Contact an appropriate hazardous-waste collector for the confirmed contents.

questions.prompt: Is the item clean and dry?

cardboard_carton.handling_guidance: Keep separate from general waste. Confirm the item condition and that the selected station accepts paper and cardboard before recycling.

disposable_utensils_straw.handling_guidance: Place used disposable utensils and straws in the appropriate general-waste stream.

questions.prompt: Did this item contain chemicals or another hazardous substance?
Is the item empty and clean?

disposable_plastic_container.handling_guidance: Keep separate from general waste. Confirm the item condition and that the selected station accepts plastic before recycling.
disposable_plastic_container.hazardous_handling_guidance: Keep separate from general waste and ordinary recycling stations. Contact an appropriate hazardous-waste collector for the confirmed contents.

foam_styrofoam.handling_guidance: Keep separate from recyclable materials and dispose of through the appropriate general-waste stream unless a specialised collection facility is available.

general_waste.handling_guidance: Bag securely and place in the appropriate general-waste collection stream.

rope_strings.handling_guidance: Bundle or contain loose rope and strings securely before placing them in the appropriate general-waste stream.

food_waste.handling_guidance: Keep separate from recyclable materials. Use composting or an organic-waste collection stream where available; otherwise use the appropriate general-waste stream.

food_wrapper.handling_guidance: Place the wrapper in the appropriate general-waste stream unless its material is specifically accepted by a local recycling facility.

dirty_tissue.handling_guidance: Bag securely and place in the appropriate general-waste stream.

used_diaper.handling_guidance: Bag securely and place in the appropriate general-waste stream.

contaminated_packaging.handling_guidance: Place in the appropriate general-waste stream when it cannot be emptied and cleaned for recycling.

electronic_waste.handling_guidance: Do not place electronic waste in normal recycling bins. Keep it dry and intact and deliver it to an authorised electronic-waste collection or recovery facility.

battery.handling_guidance: Do not place batteries in household recycling or general-waste bins. Keep terminals protected where appropriate and deliver them to an authorised battery or electronic-waste collection point.

sofa.handling_guidance: Arrange collection through an appropriate bulky-waste or furniture recovery service.

mattress.handling_guidance: Arrange collection through an appropriate bulky-waste or mattress recovery service.

large_table.handling_guidance: Arrange collection through an appropriate bulky-waste or furniture recovery service.

refrigerator.handling_guidance: Keep intact and arrange collection through a Department of Environment registered e-waste collector or licensed recovery facility; do not use ordinary recycling bins.

washing_machine.handling_guidance: Keep intact and arrange collection through a Department of Environment registered e-waste collector or licensed recovery facility; do not use ordinary recycling bins.

large_appliance.handling_guidance: Keep intact and arrange collection through a Department of Environment registered e-waste collector or licensed recovery facility; do not use ordinary recycling bins.
